verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce SaaS platform that holds merchant and customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy. The AI page items describe agent tooling and schema introspection, not training-data privacy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
